mentions.name: On-Call Burnout Detector
mentions.description: This tool detects potential signs of overwork in incident responders that could lead to burnout, computing a per-responder risk score by integrating with Rootly, PagerDuty, GitHub, and Slack. It is available both as a hosted service and as a self-hosted deployment.
mentions.problem: Overwork among incident responders that can lead to burnout.
mentions.audience: Incident responders (on-call staff) and the teams monitoring their workload
mentions.source_excerpt: A tool that detects potential signs of overwork in incident responders, which could lead to burnout. To compute a per-responder risk score, it integrates with Rootly, PagerDuty, GitHub, and Slack.

evidence.value: A tool that detects potential signs of overwork in incident responders, which could lead to burnout. To compute a per-responder risk score, it integrates with Rootly, PagerDuty, GitHub, and Slack.
